title: S.E.M 2026
subtitle: Strength. Endurance. MetCon.
purpose: Eight-week preparation for ATHX individual or pairs competition. The athlete completes the training as an individual; pair entrants share work only where the competition format allows.
tagline: STRONG ENOUGH TO LIFT HEAVY. FIT ENOUGH TO KEEP MOVING. PREPARED ENOUGH TO DO BOTH WHEN IT COUNTS.
independent_disclaimer: Produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. Not produced, approved or endorsed by ATHX.

weeks.title: Establish the standard
weeks.checkpoint: Record honest baselines, choose safe training loads and make every repetition legal.

sessions.title: Strict press baseline + upper pull
sessions.purpose: Establish a legal press marker and build upper-back support.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-12 min easy SkiErg or row, shoulder prep and progressive empty-bar presses.
blocks.standard: Front rack and overhead positions must feel stable before loading.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 3 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: No dip, bounce, knee bend or press-out. Only legal reps count.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 4 × 8-10 ring rows or chest-supported rows.
blocks.standard: Keep shoulders packed and finish every rep under control.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: 3 × 12-15 lateral raises and 3 × 15-20 band pull-aparts.
blocks.standard: Accessory work supports the lift. It should not create fatigue that affects the next session.

sessions.coach_note: Leave one clean rep available unless the session says otherwise. Strong legal attempts beat ugly max attempts.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load range. Remove one accessory set.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce strength load 5-7.5%, remove a back-off set, cut accessories in half.

sessions.title: Run-row repeatability baseline
sessions.purpose: Find sustainable category rhythm without a max test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run/row, drills and 3 × 20 sec relaxed pickups.
blocks.standard: The warm-up should make the first rep feel controlled.

blocks.name: Run-row rounds
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds: category run distance + category row distance, rest 2 min easy walk. Lite 500m, ATHX 750m, Pro 1km. RPE 7-7.5.
blocks.standard: Target repeatability. If pace collapses, the first reps were too hot.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk, easy row and calves/lats mobility.
blocks.standard: Leave breathing settled and legs ready for the next session.

sessions.coach_note: The endurance score is not just fitness. It is pacing, transitions and the ability to avoid panic.

readiness_adjustment.average: Drop RPE to 7. Add 30 sec rest.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut to 3 rounds at RPE 6-7.

sessions.title: Back squat baseline + lower support
sessions.purpose: Find a legal triple marker and build lower-body positions.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min bike or row, hips/ankles, bodyweight squats and progressive barbell sets.
blocks.standard: Depth must be repeatable before load increases.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 3 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Hip crease below top of knee. Stand tall before re-racking.

blocks.name: Lower support
blocks.instruction: 3 × 8 split squat or reverse lunge each leg at RPE 7, then 3 × 8 hamstring curl or RDL.
blocks.standard: Support work builds the lift without making Saturday heavy.

blocks.name: Flush
blocks.instruction: 6-8 min easy bike and lower-body mobility.
blocks.standard: Finish better than you started.

sessions.coach_note: A squat triple only matters if it would pass judging. Depth and control are part of the score.

readiness_adjustment.average: Lower end of range, one fewer back-off.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce squat load 5-7.5%, drop a back-off set, cut accessories.

sessions.title: MetCon repeatability EMOM
sessions.purpose: Learn station rhythm and standards without overreaching.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy machine, joint prep and one technical pass through each movement.
blocks.standard: Do not start the clock until standards are clear.

blocks.name: 24-min EMOM
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds. Min 1: 8-12 cal SkiErg. Min 2: 6-8 GTOH at SVL 2. Min 3: 15-20m sandbag carry. Min 4: 8 box reps. Min 5: 10-15m lunge. Min 6: rest.
blocks.standard: Target zero no-reps. If no-reps appear, record them and reduce volume or load next exposure.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Write the movement that limited output and the fix for next time.
blocks.standard: The review is part of the session, not admin.

sessions.coach_note: Legal movement is the standard. A faster no-rep is still slower than doing it properly.

readiness_adjustment.average: Reduce each minute's volume by 20%.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut to 3 rounds (18 min).

sessions.title: Deadlift baseline + station flow
sessions.purpose: Find a legal five-rep marker and practise low-pressure transitions.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy machine, hinge prep and progressive deadlift sets.
blocks.standard: Brace, wedge and lockout should be automatic.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 5 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Conventional stance, arms straight, no bouncing, no straps.

blocks.name: Integrated rounds
blocks.instruction: 2-4 controlled rounds: 8-12 cal SkiErg, 6 GTOH, 15-20m carry or lunge. Keep RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Connects strength to competition movement without turning Saturday into a race.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy walk or bike and hips/lats mobility.
blocks.standard: Leave enough in the legs to absorb the week.

sessions.coach_note: Deadlift success in ATHX is strength plus patience. Grip, lockout and legal rhythm matter under the clock.

readiness_adjustment.average: Lower end of range. Cut integrated to 2 rounds.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce deadlift 5-7.5%, drop a back-off, skip integrated.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + skill reset
sessions.purpose: Add aerobic volume and technical practice only when it improves the week.

blocks.name: Zone 2
blocks.instruction: 20-40 min easy bike, row, run or SkiErg at conversational effort.
blocks.standard: Should improve recovery, not steal from core sessions.

blocks.name: Skill practice
blocks.instruction: Choose one: sandbag pickup and turn, box rhythm, lunge line discipline, BBJ standards or front rack mobility. 10-15 min only.
blocks.standard: Stop before positions degrade.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 8-12 min hips, ankles, lats, shoulders and thoracic rotation.
blocks.standard: Easy range, no forced stretching.

sessions.coach_note: Optional means optional. Skip it when complete rest is the better training decision.

readiness_adjustment.average: Shorten Zone 2 by 10 min.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Skip and rest fully.

sessions.title: Full 22-minute run-row rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the scored endurance zone and set race targets.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run/row, drills and 3 × 20 sec relaxed pickups.
blocks.standard: The warm-up should make the first rep feel controlled.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 22 min: alternate category run and row distances exactly as your event requires. Record total metres, splits and transitions.
blocks.standard: Target repeatability. If pace collapses, the first reps were too hot.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk, easy row and calves/lats mobility.
blocks.standard: Leave breathing settled and legs ready for the next session.

sessions.coach_note: The endurance score is not just fitness. It is pacing, transitions and the ability to avoid panic.

readiness_adjustment.average: Drop RPE by half a point. Add 30 sec rest.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut volume by one round at RPE 6-7.

sessions.title: Low-volume back squat

blocks.name: Back squat

blocks.instruction: 6-8 min easy bike and lower-body mobility.
blocks.standard: Finish better than you started.

sessions.title: Six days out — Strength primer
sessions.purpose: Touch all three strength movements without soreness.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy SkiErg or row and progressive empty-bar work.
blocks.standard: Move smoothly.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: 3 × 3 at RPE 5-6, then 1 smooth single at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Legal lockout only.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: 3 × 3 at RPE 5-6.
blocks.standard: Clean depth.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: 2 × 3 at RPE 5-6.
blocks.standard: No grind.

sessions.coach_note: Nothing should feel heavier than 7/10.

readiness_adjustment.average: Skip the top single.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Warm-up sets only.

sessions.title: Five days out — Endurance primer
sessions.purpose: Keep category rhythm fresh without accumulating fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy run/row.
blocks.standard: Stay relaxed.

blocks.name: Rhythm intervals
blocks.instruction: 2-3 easy rounds: 2 min run + 2 min row at RPE 6, rest 90 sec. Finish with 3 × 15 sec pickups.
blocks.standard: Finish wanting to do more.

sessions.coach_note: This is a rhythm session, not a fitness test.

readiness_adjustment.average: 2 rounds only.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Easy 15-min shakeout.

sessions.title: Four days out — Movement standards primer
sessions.purpose: Touch every MetCon movement once more at easy volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy machine and mobility.
blocks.standard: Easy only.

blocks.name: Three easy rounds
blocks.instruction: 5 cal SkiErg, 3 light GTOH, 4 box reps, 10m carry, 6m lunge and 6m BBJ. Rest 90 sec.
blocks.standard: Move quickly but never strain.

sessions.coach_note: The primer should increase confidence.

readiness_adjustment.average: Two rounds only.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Skip and rest.

sessions.title: Two days out — Competition primer + kit check
sessions.purpose: Leave the body switched on and remove race-day uncertainty.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 6-8 min easy machine.
blocks.standard: Easy.

blocks.name: Two easy rounds
blocks.instruction: 4 cal SkiErg, 2 GTOH, 3 box reps, 10m carry, 4m lunge and 4m BBJ. Rest 2 min.
blocks.standard: Stop as soon as you feel sharp.

blocks.name: Equipment check
blocks.instruction: Confirm shoes, belt, sleeves, wraps, chalk, travel, food, fluids and opening attempts.
blocks.standard: No new kit or supplements on race day.

sessions.coach_note: No added work.

readiness_adjustment.average: Just the warm-up and kit check.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Kit check only.

sessions.title: Race day — ATHX performance
sessions.purpose: Produce three high-quality performances: strength, endurance and MetCon X.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Execute planned attempts for strict press, back squat and deadlift.
blocks.standard: Legal reps first.

blocks.name: Endurance
blocks.instruction: Run and row the planned rhythm. Start controlled, then build.
blocks.standard: Transitions are free speed.

blocks.name: MetCon X
blocks.instruction: Move through the stations with planned breaks and zero avoidable no-reps.
blocks.standard: Standards win when fatigue arrives.

sessions.coach_note: Race the plan, not the adrenaline.

readiness_adjustment.average: Trust the plan. Do not increase attempts.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Lower opening attempts by one increment.
